notes.title: 🐸Frog Jump - Now with Extra Chaos! (v1.1 Update)
notes.content:
[h3]🟢 Difficulty Options[/h3][p][b]Want a chill bounce or a rage-inducing leap?[/b]
Now you can choose:[/p][list][*][p]🐣 [b]Easy[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🧍 [b]Normal[/b][/p][/*][*][p]💪 [b]Hard[/b][/p][/*][*][p]💀 [b]Impossible[/b][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🏆 Leaderboards by Difficulty[/h3][p][b]Climb the ranks... separately![/b]
Each difficulty now has its own leaderboard.
Flex your skills where it counts![/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔁 Reset Game from Pause Menu[/h3][p][b]Made a wrong jump? Got stuck in a weird spot?[/b]
Now you can fully reset the level straight from the ESC menu — no need to leave the lobby.
[i]One click, clean slate.[/i][/p][hr][/hr][h3]💦 Low Settings Water Fix[/h3][p][b]White, glowy water on low settings?[/b]
Gone. Your retinas may now relax.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🎯 New Achievements[/h3][p][b]Fresh achievements added for each difficulty.[/b]
Complete them all and prove you're the jump master.[/p]
